linux-hiby-rs6 pacman repository

The [rs6] repository: Arch Linux Ports AArch64 packages for the HiBy RS6, built by GitHub Actions from the arch branch of linux-hiby-rs6 (commit @ARCH_SHA@) in bens-only Arch Linux Ports containers (ARMv8.0), with -march=armv8-a+crc+crypto -mtune=cortex-a73.cortex-a53.

The repository is unsigned. In /etc/pacman.conf, after [core] and before [extra] (the RS6 forks of extra packages keep their names and must win):

[rs6]
SigLevel = Never
Server = https://mirror.funami.tech/linux-hiby-rs6/arch/$arch
Server = @SITE_URL@/arch/$arch

Files: aarch64/rs6.db, package list, build hashes. The Nura apk repository is one level up.
